verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ אִ֥ישׁ וּשְׁמ֥וֹ מִיכָֽיְהוּ׃ מֵֽהַר־ אֶפְרָ֖יִם
verses.literal: Now a man named Micah from the hill country of Ephraim

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְאִמּ֡וֹ אֶלֶף֩ וּמֵאָ֨ה הַכֶּ֜סֶף אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֻֽקַּֽח־ לָ֗ךְ וְגַם֙ בְּאָזְנַ֔י וְאַתִּי אָמַ֣רְתְּ אָלִית֙ הִנֵּֽה־ הַכֶּ֥סֶף אִתִּ֖י אֲנִ֣י לְקַחְתִּ֑יו אִמּ֔וֹ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר בָּר֥וּךְ בְּנִ֖י לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·’im·mōw ’e·lep̄ ū·mê·’āh hak·ke·sep̄ ’ă·šer luq·qaḥ- lāḵ wə·ḡam bə·’ā·zə·nay wə·ʾat·tī ’ā·mart ’ā·lîṯ hin·nêh- hak·ke·sep̄ ’it·tî ’ă·nî lə·qaḥ·tîw ’im·mōw wat·tō·mer bā·rūḵ bə·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: said to his mother The eleven hundred [shekels] of silver that were taken from you and about which I heard you utter a curse I have the silver {here} with me I took it Then his mother said Blessed be my son by the LORD

verses.original: וַיָּ֛שֶׁב אֶת־ אֶֽלֶף־ וּמֵאָ֥ה הַכֶּ֖סֶף לְאִמּ֑וֹ אִמּ֡וֹ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר הַקְדֵּ֣שׁ הִקְדַּ֣שְׁתִּי אֶת־ הַכֶּסֶף֩ לַיהוָ֨ה מִיָּדִ֜י לִבְנִ֗י לַֽעֲשׂוֹת֙ פֶּ֣סֶל וּמַסֵּכָ֔ה וְעַתָּ֖ה אֲשִׁיבֶ֥נּוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šeḇ ’eṯ- ’e·lep̄- ū·mê·’āh hak·ke·sep̄ lə·’im·mōw ’im·mōw wat·tō·mer haq·dêš hiq·daš·tî ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ Yah·weh mî·yā·ḏî liḇ·nî la·‘ă·śō·wṯ pe·sel ū·mas·sê·ḵāh wə·‘at·tāh ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū lāḵ
verses.literal: And when he had returned . . . the eleven hundred [shekels] of silver to his mother [she] said I wholly dedicate . . . - the silver to the LORD . . . for my son’s benefit to make a graven image and a molten idol Therefore I will now return it to you

verses.original: וַיָּ֥שֶׁב אֶת־ הַכֶּ֖סֶף לְאִמּ֑וֹ אִמּוֹ֩ וַתִּקַּ֣ח מָאתַ֨יִם כֶּ֜סֶף וַתִּתְּנֵ֣הוּ לַצּוֹרֵ֗ף וַֽיַּעֲשֵׂ֙הוּ֙ פֶּ֣סֶל וּמַסֵּכָ֔ה וַיְהִ֖י בְּבֵ֥ית מִיכָֽיְהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šeḇ ’eṯ- hak·ke·sep̄ lə·’im·mōw ’im·mōw wat·tiq·qaḥ mā·ṯa·yim ke·sep̄ wat·tit·tə·nê·hū laṣ·ṣō·w·rêp̄ way·ya·‘ă·śê·hū pe·sel ū·mas·sê·ḵāh way·hî bə·ḇêṯ mî·ḵā·yə·hū
verses.literal: So he returned - the silver to his mother and she took two hundred [shekels] of silver and gave them to a silversmith who made them into a graven image and a molten idol And they were placed in the house of Micah

verses.original: וְהָאִ֣ישׁ מִיכָ֔ה ל֖וֹ בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיַּ֤עַשׂ אֵפוֹד֙ וּתְרָפִ֔ים וַיְמַלֵּ֗א אֶת־ יַ֤ד אַחַד֙ מִבָּנָ֔יו וַיְהִי־ ל֖וֹ לְכֹהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’îš mî·ḵāh lōw bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·ya·‘aś ’ê·p̄ō·wḏ ū·ṯə·rā·p̄îm way·mal·lê ’eṯ- yaḏ ’a·ḥaḏ mib·bā·nāw way·hî- lōw lə·ḵō·hên
verses.literal: Now this man Micah had a shrine . . . and he made an ephod and some household idols and ordained - - one of his sons [as] his priest

verses.original: הָהֵ֔ם בַּיָּמִ֣ים אֵ֥ין מֶ֖לֶךְ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִ֛ישׁ יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃פ הַיָּשָׁ֥ר בְּעֵינָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: hā·hêm bay·yā·mîm ’ên me·leḵ bə·yiś·rā·’êl ’îš ya·‘ă·śeh hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: In those days there was no king in Israel everyone did [what was] right in his own eyes

verses.original: וַיְהִי־ נַ֗עַר וְה֥וּא לֵוִ֖י מִבֵּ֥ית לֶ֙חֶם֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְה֥וּא גָֽר־ שָֽׁם׃ מִמִּשְׁפַּ֖חַת יְהוּדָ֑ה
verses.transliteration: way·hî- na·‘ar wə·hū lê·wî mib·bêṯ le·ḥem yə·hū·ḏāh wə·hū ḡār- šām mim·miš·pa·ḥaṯ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: And there was a young - Levite vvv from Bethlehem in Judah who had been residing . . . within the clan of Judah

verses.original: הָאִ֜ישׁ וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ מֵהָעִ֗יר מִבֵּ֥ית לֶ֙חֶם֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה לָג֖וּר בַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יִמְצָ֑א לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃ וַיָּבֹ֧א עַד־ מִיכָ֖ה בֵּ֥ית הַר־ אֶפְרַ֛יִם
verses.transliteration: hā·’îš way·yê·leḵ mê·hā·‘îr mib·bêṯ le·ḥem yə·hū·ḏāh lā·ḡūr ba·’ă·šer yim·ṣā la·‘ă·śō·wṯ dar·kōw way·yā·ḇō ‘aḏ- mî·ḵāh bêṯ har- ’ep̄·ra·yim
verses.literal: This man left the city vvv of Bethlehem in Judah to settle where he could find [a place] And as he traveled . . . he came to Micah’s house in the hill country of Ephraim

verses.original: מֵאַ֣יִן תָּב֑וֹא מִיכָ֖ה וַיֹּאמֶר־ ל֥וֹ אָנֹ֗כִי לֵוִ֣י מִבֵּ֥ית לֶ֙חֶם֙ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו וְאָנֹכִ֣י הֹלֵ֔ךְ לָג֖וּר בַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶמְצָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’a·yin tā·ḇō·w mî·ḵāh way·yō·mer- lōw ’ā·nō·ḵî lê·wî mib·bêṯ le·ḥem yə·hū·ḏāh way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw wə·’ā·nō·ḵî hō·lêḵ lā·ḡūr ba·’ă·šer ’em·ṣā
verses.literal: Where are you from Micah asked him I am a Levite vvv from Bethlehem in Judah he replied . . . and I am on my way to settle wherever I can find a place

verses.original: שְׁבָ֣ה עִמָּדִ֗י מִיכָ֜ה וַיֹּאמֶר֩ ל֨וֹ וֶֽהְיֵה־ לִי֮ לְאָ֣ב וּלְכֹהֵן֒ וְאָנֹכִ֨י אֶֽתֶּן־ לְךָ֜ עֲשֶׂ֤רֶת כֶּ֙סֶף֙ לַיָּמִ֔ים וְעֵ֥רֶךְ בְּגָדִ֖ים וּמִחְיָתֶ֑ךָ הַלֵּוִֽי׃ וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ
verses.transliteration: šə·ḇāh ‘im·mā·ḏî mî·ḵāh way·yō·mer lōw weh·yêh- lî lə·’āḇ ū·lə·ḵō·hên wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ’et·ten- lə·ḵā ‘ă·śe·reṯ ke·sep̄ lay·yā·mîm wə·‘ê·reḵ bə·ḡā·ḏîm ū·miḥ·yā·ṯe·ḵā hal·lê·wî way·yê·leḵ
verses.literal: Stay with me Micah said to him and be my father and priest and I will give you ten [shekels] of silver per year a suit of clothes and your provisions So the Levite went in

verses.original: וַיּ֥וֹאֶל הַלֵּוִ֖י לָשֶׁ֣בֶת אֶת־ הָאִ֑ישׁ הַנַּ֙עַר֙ וַיְהִ֤י כְּאַחַ֖ד מִבָּנָֽיו׃ ל֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·’el hal·lê·wî lā·še·ḇeṯ ’eṯ- hā·’îš han·na·‘ar way·hî kə·’a·ḥaḏ mib·bā·nāw lōw
verses.literal: and agreed . . . to stay with [him] and the young man became like a son to Micah

verses.original: מִיכָה֙ אֶת־ וַיְמַלֵּ֤א יַ֣ד הַלֵּוִ֔י הַנַּ֖עַר וַיְהִי־ ל֥וֹ לְכֹהֵ֑ן וַיְהִ֖י מִיכָֽה׃ בְּבֵ֥ית
verses.transliteration: mî·ḵāh ’eṯ- way·mal·lê yaḏ hal·lê·wî han·na·‘ar way·hî- lōw lə·ḵō·hên way·hî mî·ḵāh bə·ḇêṯ
verses.literal: Micah - ordained . . . the Levite and the young man became his priest and lived in [his] house

verses.original: מִיכָ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר עַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֖ה יֵיטִ֥יב לִ֑י כִּ֧י הַלֵּוִ֖י הָיָה־ לִ֛י לְכֹהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: mî·ḵāh way·yō·mer ‘at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tî kî- Yah·weh yê·ṭîḇ lî kî hal·lê·wî hā·yāh- lî lə·ḵō·hên
verses.literal: Then Micah said Now I know that the LORD will be good to me because a Levite has become my priest
